description: This file defines interfaces for the IOcdmSystem and IOcdmSystemFactory classes, which are part of a DRM system management module. It includes method declarations for retrieving system version, session limits, key store hashes, and creating sessions, among others. The file also manages dependencies and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IOcdmSystem
classes.description: Interface for managing a DRM system, including version retrieval, session management, and key store operations.

classes.name: IOcdmSystemFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IOcdmSystem based on a key system string.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IOcdmSystemFactory instance.

methods.name: createOcdmSystem
methods.description: Creates an IOcdmSystem object for a specified key system.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the DRM system.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit on the number of LDL key sessions.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store for the system.

methods.name: deleteSecureStore
methods.description: Deletes the secure store for the system.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves a hash of the key store.

methods.name: getSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves a hash of the secure store.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with a client callback.
